verdict.rationale: AI Gateway supports condition-based automation such as dynamic routing that evaluates conditions and triggers fallback/model switching, rate-limit enforcement, and adjustable rules via dashboard/API without redeploys, which aligns with event-triggered rule automation. However, this is scoped to request-routing/traffic-control events (errors, timeouts, quotas) rather than general-purpose custom event/action rule definition (e.g., arbitrary triggers like alerts firing external webhooks or custom business-logic events). missing for 10: evidence of user-defined arbitrary trigger-action rules beyond routing/fallback/rate-limiting, and evidence of alerting/webhook actions tied to custom conditions.
